steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Welcome to Manna Radio. Today we will explore the Ten Commandments that God gave to Moses on Mount Sinai.

steps.speaker: Béé
steps.text: Hi! I'm Béé! I'm so happy to be here learning with you!

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: The first commandments talk about loving God. We should put him first in our lives.

steps.speaker: Béé
steps.text: That's cool! That means God is super important to us.
What is the theme of today's episode?

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Exactly! The commandments guide us to live well, respecting God and one another.

steps.speaker: Béé
steps.text: And that makes us a better person!
Where did God give the Ten Commandments to Moses?

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Great! You've learned a lot today. See you in the next episode!

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Welcome back to Manna Radio! Today we will learn about Noah and the Great Flood.

steps.speaker: Béé
steps.text: Yay! I love this story! There are animals everywhere!

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: God asked Noah to build an ark to save his family and the animals from the flood.
What was God's request to Noah?

steps.speaker: Béé
steps.text: And Noah was very old, but he trusted in God anyway!

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: The ark was very large and carried two animals of each species, a pair. Noah worked for many years building it with faith in God.
How long did it rain during the flood?

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: When the rain stopped, God made a rainbow appear as a promise that there would never be another flood.

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Welcome to the third episode of Manna Radio! Today we will talk about Moses and the miracle of the Red Sea.

steps.speaker: Béé
steps.text: That's awesome! Water that splits? That's like magic!

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: It's not magic, it's a miracle from God! Moses led the Hebrew people to escape from Egypt, where they were slaves.
Why did the people need to leave Egypt?

steps.speaker: Béé
steps.text: And Moses used a staff to do incredible things!

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: When Pharaoh chased the people, Moses raised his staff and the waters of the Red Sea split, forming a dry path.
What did Moses do with his staff at the Red Sea?

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: The people walked between the waters and reached safety on the other side. Thank you for joining us!

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Welcome to the fourth episode of Manna Radio! Today we will talk about Samson and his extraordinary strength.

steps.speaker: Béé
steps.text: Samson? Oh yes! He was very, very strong!

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Samson received superhuman strength from God. He could defeat hundreds of enemies by himself.
Where did Samson's strength come from?

steps.speaker: Béé
steps.text: But there was a secret... His hair was important in some way!

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Yes! Samson's hair was a sign of his promise with God. As long as his hair wasn't cut, he kept his strength.
What happened to Samson's strength if his hair was cut?

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Samson teaches us that trusting in God gives us power, but we also need to be faithful. See you soon!

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Welcome to Manna Radio! Today we will talk about Esther, a courageous woman who saved her people.

steps.speaker: Béé
steps.text: Esther? What a beautiful name! What's her story?

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Esther was a Jewish woman who became queen of a powerful kingdom, even though she was an orphan.
How did Esther become queen?
options: She was born into a royal family
She was chosen by the king
steps.answer: She was chosen by the king

steps.speaker: Béé
steps.text: So what? What challenge did she face?

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: An evil man named Haman wanted to destroy all the Jews. Esther, even though afraid, went to the king and revealed the truth.
What did Esther do to save her people?
options: She was courageous and revealed the truth to the king
steps.answer: She was courageous and revealed the truth to the king

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Esther shows us that courage comes from within, and we can make a difference even when facing obstacles. See you next time!

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Welcome to the sixth episode! Today we will talk about Abraham and how his faith changed history.

steps.speaker: Béé
steps.text: Abraham! He traveled a lot, didn't he? He left his home and everything!

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Exactly! God called Abraham to leave his land and his family to go to a place he didn't know.
Why did Abraham leave his land?

steps.speaker: Béé
steps.text: But then? How did he trust if he didn't know where he was going?

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Abraham had one special thing: faith. He trusted that God would take care of him, even without knowing the way.
What is the main quality Abraham showed?

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: And so Abraham became the father of a multitude! Trusting in God opens incredible doors. Thank you for being with us!

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Welcome to the seventh episode of Manna Radio! Today we will talk about Job, a man who faced great difficulties with patience.

steps.speaker: Béé
steps.text: Difficulties? What kind of difficulties?

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Job was a very rich and respected man. But suddenly he lost everything: his family, his animals, his wealth.
How did Job react when he lost everything?

steps.speaker: Béé
steps.text: That's incredible! How did he manage to keep faith even losing everything?

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Job knew that faith doesn't depend on having many things, but on trusting in God above all.
What is the main lesson from Job's story?

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Job teaches us that even in the worst situations, we can find strength in faith. See you in the next episode!

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Welcome to the final episode of this season of Manna Radio! Today we will meet Peter, a disciple of Jesus.

steps.speaker: Béé
steps.text: Peter? He was important, wasn't he?

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Very much! Peter was a fisherman when Jesus called him. He became one of the most dedicated apostles.
What was Peter's profession before following Jesus?

steps.speaker: Béé
steps.text: And why did Jesus choose to give him the name 'Rock'?

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Jesus called Peter 'Cephas', which means 'Rock', because he would be firm and dependable in serving God.
What does the name 'Rock' symbolize in Peter's story?

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Peter teaches us that we all can change and become stronger through faith. Thank you for following Manna Radio!
